# FILIGRANA default drawings

These high-contrast SVG drawings are intended as ready-to-load examples for exploring how different path shapes affect the music. Each includes a white paper background so it can pass through the same ink detection as an uploaded drawing.

- `spiral-shell.svg` — a single spiral path, cropped from [Draw-1-line-1-spiral.svg](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Draw-1-line-1-spiral.svg) by Misibacsi. Public domain. The unrelated straight line was removed and the image was recropped for FILIGRANA.
- `branching-plant.svg` — original FILIGRANA vector artwork by Matteo Bassi.
- `water-ripples.svg` — original FILIGRANA vector artwork by Matteo Bassi.
- `constellation-lyra.svg` — simplified from [ConstellationLyra.svg](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:ConstellationLyra.svg) by Dirk Hünniger. Licensed under [CC BY-SA 3.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/) and GFDL 1.2 or later. Star and line geometry retained; lettering and unrelated glyph removed. This adapted SVG is shared under CC BY-SA 3.0.

Source drawings were chosen or drawn as clean black strokes on white backgrounds, with sparse paths that are easy to trace and audibly distinct.
